summary: Re-pin local CI publication references to merged revision and release 0.20.53

delivery.outcome: Adopter-facing local CI publication references pin the merged ticket-270 revision instead of superseded 0.20.10/d5f77d8, and the correction ships as standard 0.20.53.
nonGoals: Change the local CI publication policy itself
Re-pin adopters inside their own repositories
Waive protected checks, independent Validator or review

architecture.decision: Bind the authored document and adopter template to merge d4dab328 (which already carries the v3 policy text), bump the managed-copy digest, and advance version projections atomically to 0.20.53 for the release tag on this ticket's merge.
architecture.rollback: Publish a reviewed corrective release; never retarget an immutable version.

validation.evidence: The regression proves the policy text, AGENTS rule 11a and adopter reference still describe the unrestricted default after re-pinning.
Package regression, managed governance, scoped intent and formatting pass before publication.

commands: Goal pull-request delivery and independent exact-head Validator
Goal direct-main publication after clean merged-SHA retest
validation.evidence: Protected PR gates and trusted exact-head approval precede merge; the v0.20.53 release binds the merged commit.
